description: Cost: free. What is this DPX agent allowed to do right now? One read-only answer combining its KYA tier, its effective (tier-clamped) spend mandate, the spend policies held by the Policy Engine under its agentId or registered wallet, and the combined effective limits (the lowest cap wins). Also states what is enforced at settlement (the mandate, live) and what is advisory (policies, unless the deployment enables policy checks), and where the agent's wallet-signed audit trail lives.
name: agent.authority

audit.description: Audit endpoint and how to authorise reads.

effectiveLimits.description: perTransactionUsd and dailyUsd — the lowest of tier/mandate and policy caps; null = uncapped.

enforcement.description: What is enforced at /settle versus advisory.

identity.description: kyaLevel (effective), storedKyaLevel, leiProof, ownerEntity, walletAddress, kycAttestation.

mandate.description: Effective mandate with an active flag, or null.

policies.description: Policy Engine policies for this agent (caps, holds, blocked regions/counterparties, purposes).
